boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct, officially documented study environments in and around MTU’s Van Pelt and Opie Library, with access constraints noted.

cards.title: East Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · first floor
cards.notes: Bring your HuskyCard for after-hours entry through the west-side entrance; this first-floor reading room remains among the accessible overnight areas.
cards.short_summary: A first-floor reading room included in the library’s overnight-access area.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech identifies the East Reading Room as accessible during the library's 24/7 HuskyCard access period.
cards.source_title: J. Robert Van Pelt and John and Ruanne Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 with a valid HuskyCard when library services are closed; access excludes the Wednesday night of Winter Carnival.

cards.title: Opie Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use the west-side entrance and a valid HuskyCard after the main library closes; check the library calendar for the Winter Carnival exception.
cards.short_summary: A named first-floor reading room with overnight HuskyCard access.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech lists the Opie Reading Room among the areas accessible during 24/7 HuskyCard access.
cards.source_title: J. Robert Van Pelt and John and Ruanne Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 with a valid HuskyCard when library services are closed; access excludes the Wednesday night of Winter Carnival.

cards.title: Library 242
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · second floor
cards.notes: Check whether the computer classroom is scheduled before settling in. It has 25 Windows PCs and is part of the second-floor overnight-access area.
cards.short_summary: A 25-PC computer classroom on the library’s second floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech identifies Library 242 as an open computer classroom with 25 Windows PCs; the second floor is available during overnight HuskyCard access.
cards.source_title: Instruction Rooms | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: The room can be reserved through the Registrar. The library’s second floor is accessible 24/7 with a valid HuskyCard when the library is closed.

cards.title: Library 244
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use this room for independent work when no instruction session is underway; during the academic year, student groups can reserve it after 5 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An instruction room that converts to open study space when unscheduled.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech states that Library 244 is available as open study space when not in use and can be accessed 24/7 with a HuskyCard.
cards.source_title: Instruction Rooms | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Available for open study when not used for instruction or workshops; 24/7 HuskyCard access. Student groups may reserve after 5 p.m. in the academic year.

cards.title: Experimental Education Environment (E3)
cards.subtitle: Library 243 · Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.notes: Look for this flexible, wireless-enabled room between scheduled classes. It is intended for changing instructional layouts and is open for study when unused.
cards.short_summary: A flexible, wireless-enabled room that becomes open study space between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech says Library 243 (E3) is open, wireless-enabled study space when it is not being used for classes and is HuskyCard-accessible 24/7.
cards.source_title: Instruction Rooms | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Open study space only when not scheduled for classes; 24/7 access requires a HuskyCard.

cards.entity_name: Van Pelt and Opie Library Student Study Rooms
cards.title: Van Pelt and Opie Library Student Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · multiple floors
cards.notes: Reserve a room in advance for a focused session. Reservations are first-come, first-served, for one to four hours daily, and require timely check-in.
cards.short_summary: A reservable set of 23 student study rooms for solo or group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech offers 23 student-only study rooms; during fall and spring, they prioritize groups of 2–12, while individual study is permitted.
cards.source_title: Library Policies | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Students may reserve one room at a time for 1–4 hours per day, up to two weeks ahead; check in within 15 minutes. Seven study rooms are in the overnight-access area.

cards.title: Silent Study
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · third floor
cards.notes: Head to the third floor when you need a designated silent-study setting; the library map places it near books, maps, and the meditation area.
cards.evidence_claim: The library’s official map lists Silent Study on the third floor.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor. Consult the library’s current hours before visiting; overnight access applies to the first and second floors.

cards.entity_name: Van Pelt and Opie Library First-Floor Workstations
cards.title: Van Pelt and Opie Library First-Floor Workstations
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · first floor
cards.notes: Use a first-floor workstation for software-based coursework after regular service hours; overnight access is tied to an active HuskyCard.
cards.short_summary: First-floor computer workstations within the 24/7 access area.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech lists first-floor workstations among the library areas accessible 24/7 with a valid HuskyCard.
cards.source_title: J. Robert Van Pelt and John and Ruanne Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Open 24/7 with a valid HuskyCard when the library is closed; the library notes a Winter Carnival Wednesday-night exception.

cards.title: Patent and Trademark Resource Center (PTRC)
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · second floor
cards.notes: Use the second-floor PTRC when your project needs patent or trademark research; schedule an appointment with a librarian for search guidance.
cards.short_summary: A designated patent and trademark research center in the library.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech identifies its library as home to the Upper Peninsula’s only Patent and Trademark Resource Center and invites appointments for patent and trademark search assistance.
cards.source_title: Services for Alumni, Guests, Retirees, and Community Users | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the library’s second floor. Schedule a librarian appointment for patent and trademark-search help.

cards.entity_name: Michigan Tech Archives and Copper Country Historical Collections
cards.title: Michigan Tech Archives and Copper Country Historical Collections
cards.subtitle: Van Pelt and Opie Library · garden level
cards.notes: Plan an archives session for primary-source research. The official library map locates the collections on the garden level, and appointments are available.
cards.short_summary: A garden-level archive for university and regional primary-source research.
cards.evidence_claim: Michigan Tech’s library map places University Archives and Historical Collections on the garden level, and the library provides an appointment request option.
cards.source_title: Map | Van Pelt and Opie Library
cards.access_notes: Located on the garden level. Check current archives hours and arrange an appointment through the library before visiting.
